post.caption:
Pi is irrational: infinite, never repeating, the same ratio in every circle that has ever existed. And almost none of that matters. NASA navigates the solar system with 15 decimal places. Around 40 digits would size a circle as wide as the observable universe to within the width of an atom. Everything past that is interesting rather than useful, and we compute it into the trillions anyway.

This is video one hundred. Thank you for being here for it.
